subject: polity
title: Speaker of Lok Sabha
description: Election, qualifications, removal, powers, functions, salary — with FIRST, CITIZEN, NOTICE, ORDER, GUIDE, CASH tricks

content.overview: The Speaker is the presiding officer of Lok Sabha, elected by its members from amongst themselves. The position is crucial for parliamentary procedures.
keyPoints: ELECTION: Elected by Lok Sabha members from amongst themselves; usually from the ruling party
QUALIFICATIONS: Must be a citizen of India; at least 25 years of age; must be a member of Lok Sabha
REMOVAL: Can be removed by a resolution of Lok Sabha passed by effective majority; 14 days' advance notice required; Speaker can preside over but cannot vote on own removal motion
POWERS: Maintains order and decorum; decides whether a bill is a Money Bill; certifies bills; can suspend members for unruly behaviour; has casting vote in case of tie
FUNCTIONS: Presides over sittings; interprets rules of procedure; refers bills to committees; guides parliamentary proceedings; represents Lok Sabha externally
SALARY: Drawn from the Consolidated Fund of India; same as a Cabinet Minister
Deputy Speaker: Elected similarly; acts as Speaker when office is vacant; usually from opposition (convention)
10th Schedule: Speaker decides disqualification under Anti-Defection law
First Speaker: G.V. Mavalankar (1952-1956); First Woman Speaker: Meira Kumar (2009-2014)

SPEAKER vs PRESIDENT: Speaker presides over Lok Sabha only, President addresses joint sessions; Speaker decides Money Bill, President gives assent; Speaker is member of LS, President is not a member of either house

mnemonics.trick: FIRST = F-From members, I-In Lok Sabha, R-Ruling party usually, S-Simple majority, T-Term of House
mnemonics.explanation: Speaker is elected From amongst members, In Lok Sabha, usually from Ruling party, by Simple majority, for the Term of the House

mnemonics.trick: CITIZEN = C-Citizen of India, I-25 years (LS), T-Tenure with House, I-In Lok Sabha membership, Z-Zero office of profit, E-Elected member, N-Not disqualified
mnemonics.explanation: Speaker must be a Citizen of India, 25+ years, member of Lok Sabha, hold no office of profit, not disqualified

mnemonics.trick: NOTICE = N-14 days' Notice, O-Only Lok Sabha, T-Through resolution, I-In writing, C-Effective majority, E-Effective majority vote
mnemonics.explanation: Speaker can be removed only by Lok Sabha through a resolution with 14 days' notice, passed by effective majority

mnemonics.trick: ORDER = O-Order & decorum, R-Rules of procedure, D-Decides Money Bill, E-Expels/suspends members, R-Refers bills to committees
mnemonics.explanation: Speaker maintains Order, interprets Rules, Decides Money Bill, Expels/suspends members, Refers bills to committees

mnemonics.trick: GUIDE = G-Guides proceedings, U-Uses casting vote, I-Interprets rules, D-Decides agenda, E-External representative of LS
mnemonics.explanation: Speaker Guides proceedings, Uses casting vote (tie), Interprets rules, Decides agenda, represents Lok Sabha Externally

mnemonics.trick: CASH = C-Consolidated Fund of India, A-As Cabinet Minister, S-Salary & allowances, H-Not votable by Parliament
mnemonics.explanation: Speaker's salary is drawn from the Consolidated Fund of India, equal to a Cabinet Minister, and is not subject to parliamentary vote

quiz.question: Who was the first Speaker of Lok Sabha?
quiz.explanation: G.V. Mavalankar was the first Speaker of Lok Sabha (1952-1956)

quiz.question: How many days' notice is required for the Speaker's removal?
quiz.explanation: 14 days' advance notice is required for a resolution to remove the Speaker

quiz.question: Who decides whether a bill is a Money Bill?
quiz.explanation: The Speaker of Lok Sabha decides whether a bill is a Money Bill under Article 110

quiz.question: Speaker's salary is drawn from:
quiz.explanation: Speaker's salary is charged on the Consolidated Fund of India, equal to a Cabinet Minister

quiz.question: The first woman Speaker of Lok Sabha was:
quiz.explanation: Meira Kumar was the first woman Speaker of Lok Sabha (2009-2014)

timeline.event: First Woman Speaker Meira Kumar elected
